name: Gaurav Mahale
headline: Code. Explore. Make it useful.
introduction: I’m Gaurav, a computer science graduate with MSc Data Science studies at the University of Glasgow. I build practical applications across machine learning, mobile development, and evidence-driven AI.
about: My work connects software development with data science: from a Flutter hearing-test application to medical-image analysis, customer prediction, and retrieval-augmented generation.
I enjoy taking a problem from an initial idea to an application people can explore. I care about clear evaluation, accessible interfaces, and understanding why a system produces the results it does.

projects.title: ReliableRAG
projects.subtitle: Production RAG with Hallucination Evaluation
projects.summary: A retrieval-augmented question-answering system with citations, evaluation, and confidence-based abstention.
bullets: Combined BM25 and dense LSA retrieval with reranking to find relevant evidence.
Added source citations and abstention when retrieved evidence was insufficient.
Built an evaluation workflow covering retrieval, faithfulness, citation correctness, and abstention.
Packaged the application with FastAPI, Streamlit, Docker, and automated checks.

projects.title: Bank Marketing Prediction
projects.subtitle: Leakage-aware machine learning
projects.summary: An end-to-end classification project using the UCI Bank Marketing dataset and a Streamlit interface.
bullets: Built preprocessing and model-training pipelines for predicting term-deposit subscription.
Excluded call duration from the deployable feature set to avoid information leakage.
Compared baseline, logistic regression, decision tree, and random forest models.
Added classification evaluation, feature importance, and a Streamlit prediction interface.

projects.title: App Based Digital Audiometer
projects.subtitle: Accessible hearing assessments
projects.summary: A Flutter application offering an affordable alternative to conventional hearing-test systems.
bullets: Implemented calibration, background-noise monitoring, and full-range hearing tests with automatic audiogram generation.
Maintained a centralised database to support updates and large-scale assessments.
Added multilingual support, chatbot assistance, and doctor-referral features.

projects.title: Brain Tumour Detection using ML
projects.subtitle: Machine learning for MRI analysis
projects.summary: A machine learning and image-processing project for detecting and classifying tumours in MRI scans.
bullets: Trained and tested models to detect and classify tumours from MRI images.
Automated image preprocessing and analysis to support early-stage detection.
Focused on reducing manual review effort in medical imaging.
